subject.title: fix(crestodian): keep onboarding connected through restart

question: Should this PR be narrowed back to the Crestodian/onboarding/profile-isolation fixes before merge, or should the Kova performance-gate rewrite be intentionally reviewed and owned in this same PR?
rationale: The core bug fix appears useful, but the current head includes an unrelated automation gate rewrite that weakens validation and a release-owned changelog edit; only a maintainer can decide whether to split that automation work or intentionally keep it here after repair.

options.title: Narrow before merge
options.body: Remove the Kova/performance and CHANGELOG.md changes from this branch, keep the focused onboarding/profile fixes, and rerun review and validation.

options.title: Repair Kova in this PR
options.body: Keep the automation work only if it restores the prior record, cleanup, summary, group, and baseline integrity checks and receives focused automation-owner review.

options.title: Pause for separate automation review
options.body: Hold the PR until an automation owner confirms the Kova gate direction and the release-owned changelog edit is removed or explicitly accepted.

recommendation.title: Narrow before merge
recommendation.body: Remove the Kova/performance and CHANGELOG.md changes from this branch, keep the focused onboarding/profile fixes, and rerun review and validation.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete owns the current branch and has prior merged history in the central changed surfaces, while vincentkoc is the likely reviewer for the Kova-specific piece.
